name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-04-13, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 4.80 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
